title: STUXS Music 2.0 — Build 8
releaseNotes: Permanent offline download deduplication and idempotent cross-storage synchronization
Canonical recording identity hierarchy with strict variant preservation for remixes, live, acoustic, and instrumental versions
Safe Room/native and IndexedDB reconciliation preventing duplicate track entries
Safe migration with verified-playable native audio validation prior to legacy cleanup
Native Media3 authoritative auto-next track playback on track completion
Authoritative Repeat ONE, Repeat ALL, and Repeat OFF semantics in native ExoPlayer engine
Bounded fall-forward recovery auto-advancing past unavailable or corrupted audio streams
Exactly-once end-transition protection eliminating duplicate track skips across background states
Bounded transitional WakeLock safeguarding background track switches during screen-off deep sleep
Instantaneous React UI queue and active track state synchronization with native playback
